description: React component implementing a multi-step booking form for a mobile repair service, including form validation, user input handling, and submission logic.

methods.name: isEmail
methods.description: Validates if a string is a proper email format.

methods.name: isPhone
methods.description: Checks if a string contains at least 10 digits, representing a phone number.

methods.name: setField
methods.description: Updates form state and clears errors for a specific field.

methods.name: goNext
methods.description: Validates current step and advances to the next step if valid.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Validates form, submits repair request, handles success or error, and updates UI accordingly.
